entities.name: bringing a child to the doctor (问病)
entities.what: At 赵太丞家's open front two women have brought a child to the doctor: one sits on a bench holding a small child on her lap, the other stands behind her, and the doctor in a dark robe stands facing them, reaching toward the child, his armchair empty behind him.
entities.src: 名画记: 国医赵太丞家 (pin 48, ≈1630); 余辉: 太丞医铺
entities.note: Heads counted at zoom 3-6: two women, the doctor and one child. Second pass: the faint 'second child' at the seated woman's knee (S7.fig.child_at_knee_1547) is the women's robe folds and was retired.

entities.name: the official riding with his retinue
entities.what: The bearded official in a broad hat rides east along the street on a horse mostly hidden by a small roof; an attendant behind the horse carries a long folded object (parasol or fan) over his shoulder, a groom in dark walks at the horse's head and an attendant in pale with a pole goes in front.
entities.src: Hansen: the rider in a broad hat (plate 26, the Zhao pharmacy and the rider)
entities.note: Four men and one horse counted. The porter with shoulder-pole baskets further west (t1) walks the other way and is not of the group.

entities.name: filling buckets at the well's west end
entities.what: At the west end of the square well's platform a water carrier bends over his bucket among three more hooped buckets (two tall ones on the platform, a smaller one in front), a long pole slanting across his shoulder.
entities.src: 名画记: 方井 (pin 47, ≈2110); 余辉: 深井汲水
entities.note: The well is S6.str.square_well_2000 and the men drawing at it are S6.grp.square_well_drawers (S6). The pale shape S7.ani.pale_shape_1905 behind him is left out until it is settled.

entities.name: two long poles leaning on the 解 building's east eave
entities.what: Two long poles (double-line strokes) leaning against the east eave of the 解 building, their tops on the eave and their feet on the ground to the south-east of it: the longer one from the eave's straight part down past the bench under the eave to the silk's bottom edge, the shorter one further south-west. Props for the eave, or poles stood against the building.
entities.vis: part: the longer pole's foot at the silk's bottom edge (v ~1770)
entities.note: Pole A (1815,1598)->(1888,1771), about 188 px long, its foot est at the silk's bottom edge; pole B (1748,1669)->(1782,1750), its foot est at v ~1750. Both lean the same way, tops to the north-west. The restyle paints a pale board between them; the scan has plain silk there. Added in the merge: the structures pass and t2 each left them to the other. Whether they are the building's eave props (then part of S7.bld.jie_building_1800) is not painted: they stand on their own feet, so they are a prop.
